_doc: heavy_gate.ps1 v3 settings, read at every gate start. Missing or broken file/key -> v2.1 values (budget 14, floors 8/8, emergency 3). Env vars override: KD_GATE_BUDGET_GB KD_GATE_FLOOR_HEAVY_GB KD_GATE_FLOOR_RENDER_GB KD_GATE_FLOOR_EMERGENCY_GB KD_GATE_WAITER_CAP.
_stages_doc: Staged plan (user 2026-10-23): build/merge/selftest/measure free-RAM floor 7 -> 6.5 -> 6, one stage per day; the stage with the latest 'from' <= today wins (floor_heavy_gb is the fallback before the first stage). To HALT the descent edit/delete the later stages. The descent happens AUTOMATICALLY at local midnight (10-24 -> 6.5, 10-25 -> 6) with no human check. Render floor and emergency floor are not staged.
_floor_doc: Allowed ranges (out-of-range / NaN / text values are ignored with a CONFIG_IGNORED log line, default used): floor_heavy_gb and stage gb 6..64, floor_render_gb 6..64, floor_emergency_gb 3..8, floor_priority_gb 3..12, budget_gb 0.5..256, waiter_cap 0..1000. -Priority floor = max(floor_emergency_gb, floor_priority_gb), never above the purpose floor.
_waiter_cap_doc: Target 6. The main checkout ran 99 (= effectively off) temporarily until every caller checked the gate exit code (REVIEW-3 F1); callers fixed on kd/gate-v3, set 6 after that is merged.
